patch_description: Add a guarded iterative slope-flip escalation loop after the full polish stack. Count sign flips of np.diff(y); while flips exceed a target and correlation with the pre-loop signal stays >= 0.97, re-run the reversal damp with escalating threshold (x1.5) and a light alpha=0.85 bilateral pass, keeping the best iterate (lowest flip count). This auto-calibrates per signal and directly optimizes the slope_changes / false_reversals metrics that gate the composite, following the escalate-until-guard-trips pattern that previously lifted noise reduction. Also restore the defensive sanitization (NaN/inf interpolation, short-signal graceful fallback, all-non-finite zeros) that the current generation dropped — the 0.00 failure cluster came from contract/syntax failures on adversarial inputs, so robustness must be preserved.
